# Font adapter fixture provenance

`valid-001.woff2.b64` is a textual transport of the W3C WOFF2 conformance fixture
`conformance/fonts/wpt/valid-001.woff2` as retained by the Wuff repository at commit
`02a1f4933cbc88c293bf5eddc4ca731ea906106f` (Git blob
`5d58008f42c463e73dfeb17f7ae0405c25fea82b`). The upstream conformance directory
records these WPT fixtures as BSD-3-Clause material from web-platform-tests contributors.
This local copy is test data only; it is not a Gazette, Theme, DesignSystem, or publication font.
The decoded fixture file is 980 bytes with SHA-256
`92cd7b916e02cb77a9b21fce3b89f588ba060eda31784c693093438a1a9a8a69`.
